description: This file defines an abstract base class for numeric configurable field types in Drupal, including methods for default settings, form configuration, validation, and constraints.

classes.name: NumericItemBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing configurable numeric field type functionalities, including settings form, constraints, and validation.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the numeric field, including min, max, prefix, and suffix.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the numeric field settings, including min, max, prefix, and suffix options.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field value is empty or not, considering '0' as a valid value.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Generates validation constraints based on min and max settings.

methods.name: truncateDecimal
methods.description: Helper method to truncate a decimal number to a specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: validateMinAndMaxConfig
methods.description: Validates that the minimum value is less than or equal to the maximum value in the settings form.
